```{r, include=FALSE}
# Prepare the data 

vol_meta$Intervention <- factor(vol_meta$Intervention, lev=c('IMF', 'DCR'))
vol_meta$imf <- factor(vol_meta$imf, lev=c('1','0'))
# Race categories are 1:white, 2:black/african american, 3:other
vol_meta$race_3 <- factor(vol_meta$race_3, lev=c('0', '1', '2'))
# 0=Female 1=Male
vol_meta$sex <- factor(vol_meta$sex, lev=c('0','1'))
# 0 
vol_meta$ethnicity <- factor(vol_meta$ethnicity, lev=c('0','1'))

# Look for missing volatility (should be 0)
#colSums(is.na(vol_meta[, c('vol.ait', 'vol.un', 'vol.wt', 'vol.guni')])) 


#standardize the volatility measures to have a mean of 0 and sd of 1
vol_standardized <- vol_meta
vol_standardized <- vol_standardized %>% 
  mutate_at(
    c('vol.ait', 
      'vol.un', 
      'vol.wt', 
      'vol.guni'),
    ~(scale(.) %>% as.vector))
# mean should be 0 or as close to it as possible
mean(vol_standardized$vol.ait)
# SD should be 1
sd(vol_standardized$vol.ait)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Functions for the next code
run_vol_models <- function(vol_measure, outcomes, data) {
  # Loop the outcomes, create an lm save in models
  models <- map(
    outcomes,
    ~ lm(
      # as.formula() converts text into a regression formula
        as.formula(
          paste(
            .x,
            "~ age + sex + race_3 + ethnicity +",
            vol_measure
          )
        ),
        data = data
      )
  )
  
  # Name each model according to its outcome
  names(models) <- outcomes
  
  # Convert each model into a df cleaned by tidy
  tidy_models <- map(
  models,
  ~ {
    model <- .x

    broom::tidy(
      model,
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        N = nobs(model)
      )
  }
)

  # Take all results and make a df
  results <- bind_rows(
    tidy_models,
    .id = "Outcome"
  )
  
  # Take the results table, name a column after the diversity
  # remove the stuff we dont need and keep just the outcome rows we want
  # (df contains results for all outcomes) This can be made less redundant
  # but theres no point on wasting time 
  results <- results %>%
  filter(
    term == vol_measure) %>%
  mutate(
    vol_measure = vol_measure)
  

  return(results) 
}


```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Functions for the plots

single_plot <- function(result, subtitle) {
 
  plot <- ggplot(
  result,
  aes(
    x = Outcome,
    y = estimate
  )
) +
  # Reference line representing no association
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  
  # Confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high
    ),
    width = 0.05,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Regression estimates
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = sig),
    size = 4
  ) +
  # Flip the axes so outcome names are easier to read
  coord_flip() +
  # Filled point = significant; open point = not significant
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sig" = 19,
      "N.S." = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall Volatility in overall composition and changes in clinical outcomes",
    subtitle = subtitle,
    x = "Volatility measure",
    y = "Regression estimate",
    shape = "Statistical significance"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
  return(plot)
}




faceted_plot <- function(results, subtitle) {
  plot <- ggplot(
  results,
  aes(
    x = Volatility,
    y = estimate
  )
) +
  # Reference line representing no association
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  
  # Confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high
    ),
    width = 0.05,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
    
    
  # Regression estimates
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = sig),
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Flip the axes so outcome names are easier to read
  coord_flip() +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Outcome,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  
  # Filled point = significant; open point = not significant
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sig" = 19,
      "N.S." = 1
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Overall Volatility in overall composition and changes in clinical outcomes",
    subtitle = subtitle,
    x = "Volatility measure",
    y = "Regression estimate",
    shape = "Statistical significance"
  ) +
    
      
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
  return(plot)
}


```

``` {r, echo=FALSE}
plot_overall_results <- function(results, subtitle) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    mutate(
      sig = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
      Measurement = factor(
        Volatility,
        levels = rev(c(
          "vol.ait",
          "vol.un",
          "vol.wt",
          "vol.guni"
        )),
        labels = rev(c(
          "Aitchison volatility",
          "Unweighted UniFrac volatility",
          "Weighted UniFrac volatility",
          "Generalized UniFrac volatility"
        ))
      ),
      Outcome = case_when(
        grepl("outcome_wt_fnl", Outcome) ~ "Weight percent change",
        grepl("wc_average", Outcome) ~ "Waist circumference percent change",
        TRUE ~ as.character(Outcome)
      ),
      Outcome = factor(
        Outcome,
        levels = c(
          "Weight percent change",
          "Waist circumference percent change"
        )
      )
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Measurement, y = estimate)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = 0.05,
      linewidth = 1,
      color = "#0072B2"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = sig),
      size = 4,
      color = "#0072B2"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(~ Outcome) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Sig" = 19, "N.S." = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Volatility associations with clinical outcomes",
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Volatility measure",
      y = "Regression estimate",
      shape = "Statistical significance"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

plot_overall_results(
  all_vol_results_BL_3m,
  "IMF and DCR combined: baseline to three months"
)

plot_overall_results(
  all_vol_results_BL_6m,
  "IMF and DCR combined: baseline to six months"
)

plot_overall_results(
  all_vol_results_BL_12m,
  "IMF and DCR combined: baseline to twelve months"
)
```

# Prepare models Split by intervention
```{r, echo=FALSE}

run_intervention_vol_models <- function(data, outcomes) {
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c("vol.ait", "vol.un", "vol.wt", "vol.guni"),
    function(measure) {
      purrr::map_dfr(c("IMF", "DCR"), function(group) {
        group_data <- dplyr::filter(data, Intervention == group)

        run_vol_models(measure, outcomes, group_data) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(Intervention = group)
      }) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Volatility = measure)
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
      Outcome = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("outcome_wt_fnl", Outcome) ~ "Weight",
        grepl("wc_average", Outcome) ~ "Waist circumference",
        TRUE ~ Outcome
      )
    )
}

intervention_results_BL_3m <- run_intervention_vol_models(
  vol_BL_3m, outcomes_BL_3m
)
intervention_results_BL_6m <- run_intervention_vol_models(
  vol_BL_6m, outcomes_BL_6m
)
intervention_results_BL_12m <- run_intervention_vol_models(
  vol_BL_12m, outcomes_BL_12m
)
  

```


```{r, echo=FALSE}


plot_intervention_results <- function(results, subtitle) {

  ggplot(
    results,
    aes(
      x = Volatility,
      y = estimate,
      color = Intervention
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = conf.low,
        ymax = conf.high
      ),
      width = 0.05,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = sig),
      size = 4
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(
      Intervention ~ Outcome,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Sig" = 19,
        "N.S." = 1
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "IMF" = "#D55E00",
        "DCR" = "#0072B2"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
    title = "Overall Volatility in overall composition 
    and changes in clinical outcomes",
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Volatility measure",
      y = "Regression estimate",
      shape = "Statistical significance",
      color = "Intervention"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 21, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r data-checks, echo=FALSE}
# Test that the amount of participants is correct and we arent making graphs for 500 data points when we only want the correct 134
time_windows <- c("0-3m", "0-6m", "0-12m")
vol_measures <- c("vol.ait", "vol.un", "vol.wt", "vol.guni")

outcomes_by_window <- list(
  "0-3m" = c(
    Weight = "change_outcome_wt_fnl_3m_BL",
    Waist = "change_wc_average_3m_BL"
  ),
  "0-6m" = c(
    Weight = "change_outcome_wt_fnl_6m_BL",
    Waist = "change_wc_average_6m_BL"
  ),
  "0-12m" = c(
    Weight = "change_outcome_wt_fnl_12m_BL",
    Waist = "change_wc_average_12m_BL"
  )
)

check_rows <- lapply(time_windows, function(window) {
  dat <- vol_standardized[vol_standardized$time_change == window, ]

  duplicates <- sum(duplicated(dat$subject_id))

  data.frame(
    Time_window = window,
    Rows = nrow(dat),
    Participants = length(unique(dat$subject_id)),
    Duplicate_participant_rows = duplicates,
    Weight_available = sum(!is.na(dat[[outcomes_by_window[[window]][["Weight"]]]])),
    Waist_available = sum(!is.na(dat[[outcomes_by_window[[window]][["Waist"]]]])),
    vol_ait_available = sum(!is.na(dat[["vol.ait"]])),
    vol_un_available = sum(!is.na(dat[["vol.un"]])),
    vol_wt_available = sum(!is.na(dat[["vol.wt"]])),
    vol_guni_available = sum(!is.na(dat[["vol.guni"]]))
  )
})

data_checks <- do.call(rbind, check_rows)
knitr::kable(data_checks, caption = "Data availability by time window")

# Flag any window where a participant contributes multiple rows.
if (any(data_checks$Duplicate_participant_rows > 0)) {
  warning("At least one time window has multiple rows for a participant.")
}
```
